answer: In an agent marketplace for raven illustrations, lotus designs, and velvet textiles, each seller identity must keep a $100 bond locked while active and for 90 days after closing. Running 10,000 fake sellers therefore immobilizes $1 million, and replacing them requires fresh capital while old bonds remain locked. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes each additional sybil consume capital and cost the attacker foregone interest.
